items.exampleEn: My main collaborator on this project lives in Japan.
items.exampleZh: 我在這個計畫上的主要合作者住在日本。

items.exampleEn: The film did well commercially but got poor reviews.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影在商業上很成功，評價卻很差。

items.exampleEn: The team lost its sponsorship after a bad season.
items.exampleZh: 球隊在戰績不佳的一季之後失去了贊助。

items.exampleEn: The free gift was just a ploy to get our email addresses.
items.exampleZh: 免費贈品只是騙我們留下電子郵件地址的手段。

items.exampleEn: The hotel was built by a shipping tycoon.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店是一位航運大亨蓋的。

items.exampleEn: Your password may have been compromised, so please change it.
items.exampleZh: 你的密碼可能已經被盜用了，請更換密碼。
items.glossZh: 遭入侵的；被盜用的、受損的

items.sentenceEn: The young tycoon bought three newspapers last year.
items.sentenceZh: 那位年輕的大亨去年買下了三家報社。

items.audioEn: Thanks to sponsorship from a bank, the concert is free for everyone.
items.audioZh: 多虧一家銀行的贊助，這場音樂會人人免費。
options: A bank is paying for it

items.sentenceEn: Lower prices for one week were a clever ploy to attract buyers.
items.sentenceZh: 降價一週是吸引買家的聰明手段。

items.sentenceEn: The bank said no customer data was compromised.
items.sentenceZh: 銀行表示，沒有任何客戶資料外洩。

items.stemEn: The company's ____ helped pay for the new football stadium.
items.stemZh: 這家公司的贊助幫忙支付了新足球場的費用。

items.stemEn: The bridge's safety was ____ by years of poor repairs.
items.stemZh: 多年來修繕不當，使這座橋的安全受到損害。

items.passageEn: Last year, a sports drink company announced its sponsorship of a city marathon. At first, some runners thought it was just a marketing ploy, but the company also paid for free health checks for every runner. Its owner, a businessman often called a drinks tycoon, said he wanted to give something back to the city where he grew up. He chose a former athlete as his main collaborator to oversee the event. The marathon was commercially successful, and a new record was set. The only problem came when the online sign-up system was compromised, and some runners had to register again by phone.
items.passageZh: 去年，一家運動飲料公司表示將贊助城市馬拉松。起初，有些跑者認為這只是行銷手段，但這家公司也替每位跑者支付免費健康檢查的費用。公司老闆常被稱為飲料大亨，他說想回饋自己長大的城市。他選了一位前運動員當主要合作夥伴，負責監督整個活動。這場馬拉松在商業上很成功，還創下了新紀錄。唯一的問題是線上報名系統遭到入侵，有些跑者只好用電話重新報名。

questions.questionZh: 除了贊助，這家公司還做了什麼？
options: 送每位跑者一雙新跑鞋
幫城市蓋了新的運動場
替每位跑者支付免費健康檢查

questions.questionZh: 這場活動唯一發生的問題是什麼？
options: 有些跑者在中途迷路了

items.promptZh: 這款遊戲在商業上很成功，賣出了一百萬套。
referenceEn: The game was commercially successful and sold a million copies.
Commercially, the game was a big success, selling one million copies.
rubricZh: commercially 是副詞，表示「在商業上」（例如 commercially successful 等）
「賣出一百萬套」可寫，例如 sold a million copies、sold one million copies 等

items.promptZh: 這位導演和她多年的合作夥伴一起拍了這部紀錄片。
referenceEn: The director made this documentary together with her collaborator of many years.
The director and her long-term collaborator made this documentary together.
rubricZh: 「合作夥伴」用 collaborator（例如 her long-term collaborator 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：compromised 第一義「外洩的」偏窄：例句（密碼）可通，但本課短文 "the online sign-up system was compromised" 譯「遭到入侵」、mcq 是檔案遭入侵，都不是「外洩」。C1 資安情境最常用義較貼近「遭入侵的、被盜用的」；建議第一義改「遭入侵的、被盜用的」，外洩可併入。是否合單元主題（商業贊助、合作）也較弱，但資安用法確為現代最常見義，可接受。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示第一義改「遭入侵的」，釋義「遭入侵的；被盜用的、受損的」；例句中譯改「被盜用」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：compromised mcq 與卡都是資料或密碼外洩
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改用「受損」義 The bridge's safety was ____ by years of poor repairs.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：commercially 是副詞，表示「在商業上」（例如 commercially successful 等）／「賣出一百萬套」可寫，例如 sold a million copies、sold one million copies 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（collaborator）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u25-l02-q15；目標字沿用 collaborator
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這位導演和她多年的合作夥伴一起拍了這部紀錄片。」、hintWords ["collaborator"]、referenceEn ["The director made this documentary together with her collaborator of many years.","The director and her long-term collaborator made this documentary together."]、rubricZh ["「合作夥伴」用 collaborator（例如 her long-term collaborator 等）","「拍了」可寫，例如 made、filmed 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 collaborator 造一個句子，說說你曾經和誰一起完成一件事。」、referenceEn ["Amy and I were collaborators on a school play.","My cousin was my collaborator when we made a short film."]）
